newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SERVGRO TO LIST S.AFRICAN AVIS IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: SERVGRO TO LIST S.AFRICAN AVIS IN APRIL.

text.p: South African-based Avis Holdings and parent group Servgro Ltd said on Monday they would list the car rental concern on the Johannesburg, Namibian and Botswanan stock exchanges in April.
The firm is the largest Avis licensee outside the United States and to the year ended March, 1996, posted a net profit of 35 million rand on a turnover of 308 million rand.
Its two main operations are Avis Rent-A-Car, which has 39 percent of the South African market, and Avis Fleet Services, a full maintenance leasing operation.

It also has interests elsewhere in the Southern African region. It owns Avis operations in Botswana, Namibia and Swaziland and manages Avis sub-licensees in Angola, Lesotho, Madagascar, Malawi, Mozambique, Zambia and Zimbabwe.

Chief executive Glenn van Heerden said the listings were intended to broaden the group's shareholder base and enhance its investment profile. The move also positioned Avis to exploit attractive growth opportunities, he said.
